findings.title: Required source and historical references bypassed excluded-topic scope
findings.baselineObservation: Initial selectContext accepted an otherwise valid catalog and reintroduced counseling Source metadata through topic.sourceIds, record.sourceIds, finding.sourceIds and provenance references. A required excluded historical record also returned its reference metadata and sources. Initial 15 existing tests passed despite these paths. Baseline code was observed before concurrent repair; no immutable baseline commit/hash claim is made.

successorEvidence.behavior: All required source routes use addSource and require every declared source topic to remain allowed. Required excluded historical/current records explicitly refuse. Details return only sourceId/recordId; no source prose or relation meaning is returned. Unrelated excluded history and unscoped unread metadata locators preserve their previous behavior.

findings.title: Source inventory starved current decisions and findings on the first bounded page

successorEvidence.ordering: Topics, current actual-user and source-owner decisions, unresolved/current constraints, P1/P2/P3 findings, source inventory, other/history records, historical references, relations. Ties remain deterministic.

findings.interpretation: Verified first-page usefulness changed for this catalog. Total closure remains broad and unchanged. This is not empirical optimization, lower aggregate bytes, reduced source exposure, learner benefit or proof of faster work.

checks: Every compact JSON response byte count equals usedBytes and stays within maxBytes.
Concatenated pages exactly equal the complete high-budget result for the same query.
No duplicate item IDs and no missing ordered items.
Continuation terminates without silently truncating closure.

independentValidation.cursorChecks: Changed byte budget rejects cursor-query-mismatch; changed catalog content rejects stale-catalog-cursor. Existing focused tests cover topic/history binding, malformed cursors, offset bounds, deterministic pages and object-key-order stability.
independentValidation.graphChecks: Containment, dependency and revision each validate their combined explicit and shorthand edges independently; semantic cycles and repeated workflow cycles remain allowed. Ancestor and dependency closure does not flatten them into one DAG.
independentValidation.pinAndPrivacyChecks: Validator checks supplied metadata syntax, references and declared byte/hash pairs only. It does not open paths or claim hashes prove currentness, permission or mathematical validity. Null pins are limited to explicitly unread no-content-read sources. No real source payload/credential was opened by this selector review.
independentValidation.typecheck: Not independently rerun in ACX-REVIEW-SELECTOR-001; implementer reports compatibility tsc5.9.3 passed. This review independently ran Bun focused tests and metadata mutations/pagination.

advisoryObservations.detail: Class-preparation dependency closure selects 47 of 48 source locators and all16 findings through broad foundations/ancestors. Ordering fixes first-page starvation without narrowing this closure. A later owner-selected relevance model may separate direct task evidence from optional foundation inventory while preserving complete references and holds.

CTX-COMPLETION is tagged lesson/progress/homework/clinic but not class-preparation. The class-preparation packet includes classroomCyclePolicy source yet omits this concise completion distinction record. Consider domain-owner review of preparation/pending relevance before changing tags or dependency edges.

Unread-note prose regex is a brittle extra metadata convention. The actual no-content-read policy and null hash/length pair remain the semantic boundary; future schema work should prefer explicit fields over expanding English phrase matching.

limitations: Review covers only the enumerated selector/validator/types/tests/config/catalog bytes; changes need a successor hash binding.
Catalog cursor currentness means exact supplied catalog content, not fresh native/remote source state.
The default date/class/student tuple describes navigation; this pure selector does not read an actual class roster or student state.
No full private-history reconstruction, canonical Memory admission, native activation, operational execution, publication or user acceptance is established.
